article_title: US ranchers wrestle with soaring costs - and their loyalty to Trump

tasks.prompt: What central tension does the article examine?
options: Whether Nebraska should replace cattle farming with technology firms
How ranchers can avoid every effect of drought by importing beef
Why all farmers in Nebraska now support an independent Senate candidate
How mounting agricultural costs and policy shocks are testing some conservative ranchers' loyalty to Donald Trump
tasks.correct_answer: How mounting agricultural costs and policy shocks are testing some conservative ranchers' loyalty to Donald Trump
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בוחנת כיצד עלויות עולות והחלטות ממשל פוגעות בחקלאים שמרנים, אך אינן מובילות בהכרח לנטישה מלאה של טראמפ.

tasks.prompt: What combination of events sharply increased Yvette Mannon's costs?
options: A flood destroyed her cattle and reduced steel prices.
A wildfire destroyed grazing land and fencing, while steel and diesel costs rose.
She bought a second ranch just before cattle prices increased.
New environmental rules forced her to sell all 300 cattle.
tasks.correct_answer: A wildfire destroyed grazing land and fencing, while steel and diesel costs rose.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: השריפה החריבה שטחי מרעה וגדרות; במקביל מחירי הפלדה והסולר עלו, והיא נאלצה גם לספק חציר מדי יום.

tasks.prompt: What does “the cattle market tanked” mean in the article?
options: The market rose gradually after the import announcement.
Cattle were moved into storage tanks.
The market fell sharply and suddenly.
The market stopped measuring cattle by weight.
tasks.correct_answer: The market fell sharply and suddenly.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: tanked הוא ביטוי לירידה חדה ומהירה; לפי הכתבה השוק צנח מיד לאחר ההודעה על יבוא הבשר.

tasks.prompt: Why did the Trump administration announce duty-free foreign beef imports?
options: To rebuild fences destroyed by wildfire
To raise cattle prices before the autumn sales period
To help Nebraska feedlots buy more machinery
To try to lower consumer beef prices
tasks.correct_answer: To try to lower consumer beef prices
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הממשל הודיע על יבוא 300 אלף טונות של בשר ללא מכס במטרה להוזיל מחירים לצרכנים.

tasks.prompt: Why can a price drop from $240 to $225 per hundredweight be severe for Jake Wolfinger?
options: Applied across thousands of cattle, the lower price can reduce revenue by hundreds of dollars per animal.
It forces him to replace all cattle with imported beef.
It automatically doubles the cost of every gallon of diesel.
The smaller price makes his feedlot legally dilapidated.
tasks.correct_answer: Applied across thousands of cattle, the lower price can reduce revenue by hundreds of dollars per animal.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הפרש קטן יחסית ליחידת משקל מצטבר לסכום גדול כאשר מדובר באלפי בעלי חיים, ולכן ההפסד לכל ראש עשוי להגיע למאות דולרים.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “reassessing their political allegiances” mean?
options: Calculating the weight of cattle again
Changing the boundaries of their ranches
Reviewing which political leaders or parties they support
Applying for larger bank credit lines
tasks.correct_answer: Reviewing which political leaders or parties they support
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר בחינה מחדש של הנאמנות והתמיכה הפוליטית בעקבות הלחצים הכלכליים ומדיניות הממשלה.

tasks.prompt: What economic pressures does the article identify across Nebraska agriculture?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין לפחות ארבעה לחצים מדויקים: סולר ודשן, מכסים על ציוד וחומרים, יבוא בשר, שוק בקר יורד, בצורת או צורך באשראי.
expected_points: The Iran War drove diesel and fertiliser prices sharply higher.
Tariffs increased costs for machinery, repairs, steel and lumber.
Foreign beef imports and other policy decisions destabilised cattle markets.
Drought, low herd numbers and a market downturn added pressure.
Some producers lost hundreds of dollars per animal or needed larger credit lines.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the range of political reactions among the ranchers and farmers interviewed.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג את תחושת הבגידה והביקורת לצד המשך התמיכה מטעמים שמרניים, וכן דוגמאות לג'נקינס, וולפינגר, קימבל, קנטרל ובייטי.
expected_points: Mannon felt betrayed and expected agriculture to express frustration at the midterms.
Jenkins, a long-time Trump critic, viewed the president's policies as impractical and harmful.
Wolfinger and Kimball criticised some decisions but did not blame Trump for every problem and retained substantial support.
Cantrell prioritised government efficiency and conservative values, while Batie said some Republicans were no longer Trump supporters.

tasks.prompt: Why have economic complaints not automatically ended Trump's support among many Nebraska voters?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהזהות השמרנית, סוגיות חברתיות, הרצון בצמצום ממשל והאמונה בכיוון הכללי של טראמפ מתקיימים לצד ביקורת כלכלית.
expected_points: Many voters identify strongly as conservatives or Republicans.
Trump's positions on abortion, Christianity and government waste align with their values.
Some distinguish long-term cost trends or the Iran War from policies they attribute directly to Trump.
Supporters may criticise particular interventions while still believing his overall direction is right.

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced analytical paragraph explaining how policy uncertainty affects ranch business decisions.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין הכרזות פתאומיות, מכסים, יבוא ועלויות דלק לבין תכנון, אשראי, הכנסות והשקעות, תוך הכרה גם במחזוריות הטבעית של שוק הבקר.
expected_points: Ranchers make long-term plans for herds, equipment, fencing and feed.
Sudden tariff, import or border decisions can change both costs and sale prices.
Unpredictability can reduce margins and force operators to seek more credit or delay investment.
The article also notes that cattle markets naturally move through long cycles, so policy is one factor among several.
